#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a project kickoff meeting ICS file for next Monday, 10:00-12:00 local time."""
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta, timezone

OUTPUT = "project_kickoff_meeting.ics"


def next_monday(today: date) -> date:
    days_ahead = (7 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def local_tzid() -> str:
    """Best-effort IANA timezone id for the runtime's local timezone."""
    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

        tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
        key = getattr(tz, "key", None)
        if key and key != "localtime":
            ZoneInfo(key)  # validate it is a real IANA key
            return key
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "UTC"


today = date.today()
monday = next_monday(today)
tzid = local_tzid()

dtstart = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, 0)
dtend = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 12, 0, 0)
dtstamp_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

uid = f"project-kickoff-{monday.isoformat()}@calendar-skill"

ics = (
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\n"
    "VERSION:2.0\n"
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN\n"
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\n"
    "METHOD:PUBLISH\n"
    "BEGIN:VEVENT\n"
    f"UID:{uid}\n"
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp_utc}\n"
    f"DTSTART;TZID={tzid}:{dtstart.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}\n"
    f"DTEND;TZID={tzid}:{dtend.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}\n"
    "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting\n"
    "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting.\n"
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED\n"
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE\n"
    "SEQUENCE:0\n"
    "BEGIN:VALARM\n"
    "ACTION:DISPLAY\n"
    "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting starts soon\n"
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M\n"
    "END:VALARM\n"
    "END:VEVENT\n"
    "END:VCALENDAR\n"
)

with open(OUTPUT, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\r\n") as f:
    f.write(ics)

print(f"Created {OUTPUT}")
print(f"Event date (next Monday): {monday.isoformat()} ({monday.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start: {monday.isoformat()} 10:00 ({tzid})")
print(f"End:   {monday.isoformat()} 12:00 ({tzid})")
print("Duration: 2 hours")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate the generated ICS file: required fields, structure, and parse with icalendar if available."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("project_kickoff_meeting.ics")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

required = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    "UID:",
    "DTSTAMP:",
    "DTSTART;TZID=",
    "DTEND;TZID=",
    "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

errors = [r for r in required if r not in text]
if errors:
    print("FAILED - missing:", errors)
    sys.exit(1)

long_lines = [i for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1) if len(line.encode()) > 75]
if long_lines:
    print(f"WARNING: lines exceed 75 octets: {long_lines}")

try:
    from icalendar import Calendar

    cal = Calendar.from_ical(text.encode("utf-8"))
    events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    if len(events) != 1:
        print(f"FAILED - expected 1 VEVENT, found {len(events)}")
        sys.exit(1)
    ev = events[0]
    print(f"Parsed OK: {ev.get('summary')} | start={ev.get('dtstart').dt} end={ev.get('dtend').dt}")
except ImportError:
    print("icalendar not installed; structural validation only")

print("Validation passed")
